dct_description_sm: This series of cross-tabulations will present a portrait of Canada based on various census topics. They will range in complexity and will be available for various levels of geography. A number of the tabulations will be available on the day of release for each topic, while others will follow several months later. Content varies form a simple overview of the country, then move to more complex cross-tabulations and will include current and previous census data.
